nodes.label: MSAccess-CLI-Agent Project
nodes.rationale: VS Code agent powered by GitHub Copilot Chat that translates plain English into PowerShell commands manipulating Access databases live via COM. No MCP server, no Python, no extra processes â€” pure PowerShell 5.1+ on Windows.

nodes.label: AccessPOSH PowerShell Module
nodes.rationale: PowerShell port of unmateria/MCP-Access expanded to 93 public functions covering databases, tables, forms, controls, VBA/VBE, SQL, reports, imports, security, and UI automation. Runs directly in the VS Code integrated terminal via COM.

nodes.label: COM Automation Architecture
nodes.rationale: No separate server â€” the module runs directly in the VS Code integrated terminal. No Python/Node â€” pure PowerShell 5.1+. Full COM access via DAO/Access Object Model â€” everything you can do from VBA, you can do from the agent.

nodes.label: ShouldProcess / WhatIf Pattern
nodes.rationale: ConfirmImpact='Medium' chosen because default $ConfirmPreference is 'High'. Since Medium < High, no automatic prompts occur in agent sessions. Agents retain full -WhatIf support for dry-runs and can pass -Confirm explicitly for interactive safety checks.

nodes.label: Parameter Validation Design Decision
nodes.rationale: [Parameter(Mandatory)] is deliberately avoided because it causes PowerShell to block and interactively prompt the user, hanging agent automation sessions indefinitely. Manual guards with throw provide immediate terminating errors agents can catch. ValidateNotNullOrEmpty is added as belt-and-suspenders without triggering interactive prompts.

nodes.label: ThrowTerminatingError Pattern
nodes.rationale: All 'throw string' replaced with $PSCmdlet.ThrowTerminatingError() with ErrorRecord objects in 4 core files (117 replacements). Preserves ErrorCategory, TargetObject, and proper InvocationInfo for downstream error handling.

nodes.label: COM Object Disposal Pattern
nodes.rationale: ReleaseComObject added for all major DAO objects ($db, $rs, $rel, $td, $fld) across the three most SQL-intensive files to prevent COM reference leaks.

nodes.label: Session Singleton Pattern
nodes.rationale: Single $script:AccessSession object manages the COM application instance, database path, and caches. Limits concurrency to one database at a time but simplifies state management for agent automation.

nodes.label: Whitespace-Normalized Patch Matching
nodes.rationale: Three-layer matching strategy: (1) exact string match, (2) whitespace-normalized fallback via Test-WsNormalizedMatch, (3) context error reporting via Get-ClosestMatchContext. This handles VBA editor reformatting and indentation drift without silently applying wrong patches.

nodes.label: PrintWindow Screenshot Capture
nodes.rationale: Uses Win32 PrintWindow with PW_RENDERFULLCONTENT flag for reliable off-screen capture of Access windows, rather than BitBlt screen capture which fails for minimized/occluded windows. Optional MaxWidth resize prevents oversized images.

nodes.label: VBE Code Caching Strategy
nodes.rationale: VBE CodeModule reads are cached per object_type:object_name key in AccessSession.VbeCodeCache and AccessSession.CmCache. All mutation operations (Set-AccessVbeLine, Set-AccessVbeProc, Update-AccessVbeProc, Add-AccessVbeCode) explicitly invalidate both caches after writes to prevent stale reads.
